measures.item: tripod head with the missing camera plate
measures.what: Find the tripod/head brand and model markings. Describe the empty plate socket and locking mechanism (sliding dovetail, drop-in recess with a lever, or something else). If possible measure the socket opening length and width in mm, and say what camera you want to mount.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: Check for brand/model markings and describe how the plate is retained. For a dovetail clamp, measure the narrow opening between the upper jaw lips, the wider gap below those lips, and the vertical depth from the lips to the plate-supporting floor (mm), with the clamp closed at its normal locking setting. Is the 38 mm width at the wide bottom of the plate? Say if you cannot measure these.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.item: salvaged webcam-mount bolt and camera mounting socket
measures.what: Measure the bolt's under-head-to-tip length, head diameter and head height (mm), and whether the head has a screwdriver slot or hand grip. With the camera powered off, gently use a blunt nonmetallic probe to measure the usable socket depth without forcing it. Also report the camera model or approximate mass; say if anything isn't available.
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: Can you measure the narrow gap between the retaining jaw lips and their height above the plate-supporting floor, in mm? Also give a brand/model if visible. Please explicitly say 'can't measure' if unavailable; 38 mm plate width alone does not establish a locking profile.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: What is its usable depth in mm, gently measured using a blunt nonmetallic probe? What is the camera model or mass? Please explicitly say if unavailable. The bolt is about 10 mm long, so we need to prevent it bottoming out.
measures.reply: camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)
